title: Console: Fleet Reconcile & Scaling Reconcile Dashboard
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Build a new Console dashboard and operator surface that centralizes fleet "reconciliation" operations and historical scaling activity. This dashboard should make it straightforward for operators to: view recent scaling decisions and why they happened, replay changes against throughput timelines, edit autoscaling policies and force a reconciliation, and audit changes for compliance.

Goals:
- Surface a single-pane-of-glass for fleet scaling events and operator actions across Dedicated capacity pools.
- Visualize throughput guarantees with actual observed throughput, headroom, and SLA breach windows.
- Provide a safe operator flow to edit autoscale policies (thresholds, cooldowns, max/min capacity) with a dry-run replay and reversible rollouts.
- Ensure all operator actions, rollbacks, and automatic reconciliations are captured in an auditable change history tied to RBAC identity and request IDs.

Success criteria (measurable):
- Console dashboard shows latency/throughput overlays and scaling event markers for 30 days with 1-minute granularity.
- Operators can run a policy dry-run that simulates capacity changes and produces estimated cost delta in < 10s.
- All manual reconciles and policy edits create immutable audit entries (creator, timestamp, before/after config, justification) and are queryable via the Console and Audit API.
- No regression in existing fleet telemetry ingestion; end-to-end test coverage for reconciliation API and UI flows.

Background and motivation:
Customers running Dedicated capacity have asked for clearer explainability around why autoscaling "churns" occur, and a safer way to intervene when policy tuning is needed. Existing Console surfaces show throughput and individual scaling events, but there is no combined operator-first surface that ties policy config, metric evidence, and an auditable action log together with a replay capability. This leads to lengthy incident cycles and cautious rollbacks.

Proposed design (high level):
- New Console page: Fleet Reconcile Dashboard. Sections: (1) Fleet selector + current policy summary panel, (2) Time-series canvas with throughput / latency / headroom overlays and annotated scaling events, (3) Policy editor modal with Dry-Run button, (4) Change history drawer with filters (actor, type, outcome), (5) Quick actions: Force reconcile, Pause autoscaling, Rollback last change.
- Backend: Reconciliation API that accepts a dry-run flag and returns a predicted scaling timeline + cost estimate using the same planner used by autoscaler. Audit log entries are emitted to the audit service on any non-read operator action.
- Telemetry: New metrics for dry-run latency, reconcile duration, and reconciliation_result (success/fallback/no-op). Enhance existing throughput events with event_reason tags to explain source (policy-trigger, manual-reconcile, scale-fallback).

Rollout plan:
1) Backend API + dry-run implementation behind feature flag (ENG).
2) Internal-only Console page for SRE & Solutions (alpha).
3) Open to Limited customers with opt-in (beta) + guided migration doc.
4) General availability with audit retention defaults and RBAC gating.

Telemetry & alerting:
- Dashboard should include SLOs: reconcile API p95 < 2s, dry-run p95 < 10s.
- Alerts when reconciliation_result == fallback with count > 5 in 10m.
- Track customer-facing metric: manual_reconciles_per_week to detect operator churn after policy changes.

Security & compliance:
- All operator actions recorded with user identity and reason field. Must pass security review for audit export and for on-prem/private deployments where customers enforce stricter retention.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should dry-run estimates include cost delta at hourly granularity or per-minute? (ask FinOps)
- RBAC mappings: which roles can force-reconcile vs. only propose edits?
- Default retention for change history in Hosted vs. Dedicated vs. Private (customer-configurable?)

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Dry-run planner diverges from live autoscaler -> mitigation: use exact same planner/constraints and surface confidence with error bands.
- Risk: Audit volume spikes -> mitigation: batched writes and retention tiering; opt-in long-term retention.

Next steps / immediate tasks:
- PM: draft final priority and acceptance criteria (this ticket).
- ENG: prototype Reconcile API and map telemetry schema changes (ENG owners assigned).
- Design: wireframes for Dry-Run modal and change history drawer.
- Security: schedule review for audit export shape and retention controls.
